analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 66.9 to 60.4, initiating cooling from overbought territory. MACD histogram also worsened from 0.6233 to 0.2468, confirming a slowdown in upward momentum. Volume ratio at 0.77 of the 5-day average indicates subdued activity, reducing conviction in trend strength. Current price of $187.05 is near the swing resistance of $187.28, limiting further upside potential. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
